# ProjectPro

> ProjectPro offers 250+ hands-on data science, machine learning, and big data projects with production-ready source code across Python, cloud platforms, and modern AI frameworks.

ProjectPro is a comprehensive learning platform providing end-to-end project-based training in data science, machine learning, deep learning, and big data engineering. The platform covers enterprise technologies including AWS, Azure, Apache Spark, Kafka, and emerging AI/ML tools like LLMs and RAG systems, enabling learners to build portfolio-worthy projects with real-world applications.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Deep Learning
- Big Data Engineering
- Python
- Apache Spark
- PySpark
- AWS
- Azure
- ETL Pipelines
- MLOps
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- RAG Systems
- Real-time Streaming
- LLMs & GenAI
- Data Science

## Data Science & Machine Learning Projects

- [250+ Data Science Projects for Your Portfolio [Python Code]](https://www.projectpro.io/projects/data-science-projects): 250+ real-world data science projects in Python, GenAI, RAG, MLOps
- [200+ End to End Data Science Projects with Python Source Code](https://www.projectpro.io/projects/data-science-projects/data-science-projects-in-python): 200+ end-to-end Python data science projects with MLOps, RAG
- [100+ Python Machine Learning Projects with Source Code](https://www.projectpro.io/projects/data-science-projects/machine-learning-projects-in-python): 100+ Python ML projects with scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, NLP
- [Data Science in Finance - Projects, and Use Cases | ProjectPro](https://www.projectpro.io/projects/data-science-projects/data-science-in-finance): Finance projects with loan prediction, credit risk, anomaly detection
